gaps: Some Fortinet Document Library pages were indexed but returned HTTP 403 when opened directly; source text was taken from official indexed pages or official PDFs where available.
FortiSIEM HA architecture source is the 7.3.5 EventDB guide because the community failure concerns PostgreSQL CMDB replication; it is not a ClickHouse shard lesson.
FortiAuthenticator RadSec server details are taken from the official 8.0.0 Admin Guide PDF, with 8.0.3 policy documentation used for current RADIUS policy context.
